## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## How was it checked?

List the relevant commands, results, and any checks you could not run.
For visual changes, include before/after captures. For runtime performance
changes, include paired GBA cycle measurements and pixel/state parity.

## Compatibility

Mention changes to Lua behavior, project files, renderer eligibility, or
required toolchains. Write “unchanged” if none apply.
